criteria.text: Calculates the last date to serve non-renewal notice as 10 July 2027 (90 days before the 8 October 2027 expiry), and warns that otherwise the agreement renews for 2 years.

Identifies that data protection breaches are not carved out of the $1,000,000 liability cap in Clause 11, leaving the customer under-protected for data breach losses, and recommends a separate higher cap or carve-out.
Calculates the service credit as $12,000 (10% of the $120,000 monthly fee for 98.6% availability) and identifies that the supplier's offer of $6,000 is too low.
Shows the service credit arithmetic (10% x $120,000 = $12,000) and flags the discrepancy with $6,000.
Gives the notice window as 90 days and as the date 10 July 2027, with days remaining from 7 April 2027 (94 days).
Where a defined term or clause is ambiguous, explains how each alternative reading would work.
